messageHandlers.script:
# v1.0.0 (P-PLN1 S1): WOMaint handoff requested from inside the planner
	# iframe (POST /planner/open -> sendMessage into this page). Same proven
	# session handoff as CalendarDayDrill: womaintWoId / womaintShortWoId.
	try:
		woId = int(float((payload or {}).get('woId') or 0))
	except:
		woId = 0
	if woId <= 0:
		return
	self.session.custom.womaintWoId = woId
	self.session.custom.womaintShortWoId = str((payload or {}).get('shortId') or '')
	workmate.diag.forensic(self.session, 'PlannerCalendar', 'open WO %s in WOMaint' % woId)
	system.perspective.navigate('/WOMaint')
